title: glab api projects/${project}/merge_requests/${n}/approvals
description: The approvals of one open merge request, ${project} the project's path URL-encoded and ${n} its iid, which kit folds into the open change's reviewers in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:open-prs, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::gitlab_pr). Every tier answers it; GitLab Community Edition answers with fewer attributes, approved_by among them. approved_by lists every user who approved, whether an approval rule counts them or not, each with when they did. The fields are those of GET /projects/:id/merge_requests/:merge_request_iid/approvals in https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_request_approvals/.
